title: 8 Jn what place this kingdome is adminiſtred.

segments.text:
THIS kingdome, as concerning the beginning or gathering thereof, is adminiſtred here on earth: yet ſo, that it is not in any one certain place, Iland, Prouince, but is ſpred through the whole world. 1. Timo. 2.8. J wil that the men praie euerie where. Matth. 18.20. Where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am J in the midſt of them. Wee neuer go out of this kingdome, if we abide in true faith. This kingdome, as touching the conſummation or perfection thereof, is adminiſtred in heauen. Ioh. 14.3. And although I go to prepare a place for you, J wil come againe, and receiue you vnto my ſelfe, that where I am, there maie yee bee alſo. Ioh. 12.26. Where I am, there
ſhal alſo my ſeruant be. Ioh. 17.24. Father, I wil that they which thou haſt giuen me, be with me, euen where I am. 1. Theſ. 4.17. We ſhal be caught vp to meete the Lord.
